traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Putranjivaceae: leaves usually alternate, rarely opposite; leaves simple; margins entire or dentate; veins pinnate; leaves evergreen; stipules present; plants monoecious, dioecious or polygamous, rarely hermaphrodite; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit drupe; stamens 2 to 50; carpels 1 to 6. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
